entry.prompt: Low-poly game asset for a top-down strategy game: an elven castle keep. One tall elegant pale stone keep, taller than every other building, with three slender round towers and curved spire roofs, an arched gate and blue banners.

style.suffix: Pale ivory stone and smooth silver-grey living wood, sweeping curved leaf-shaped roofs, slender pillars, gold trim, climbing vines. Graceful low-poly shapes, clean edges, flat faces. Isolated building, no ground, no text, no characters.
style.texture: Stylized matte painted colours, even lighting, no baked shadows. Stone: pale ivory (#E6E0CE). Wood: silver birch grey (#BDB5A2). Roofs: soft leaf green (#6E9A55) with lighter edges (#9DBB72). Trim: muted gold (#C9A650). Vines: fresh green (#5E8A4A). Banners and cloth: saturated royal blue (#2B4FB0), no emblem. No text or logos.
